title: Runtime routes
summary: Route keys mirrored for compatible gateway integrations.
purpose: Maps stable route keys to paths without making this package the protocol owner.
lifecycle: Resolved when constructing a gateway request and discarded after transport dispatch.

fieldConstraints.constraint: Must be a member of the packed TeamRouteKey union.

behavior.errors: Unknown keys are rejected by typed callers or the resolver.
behavior.retry: Route resolution itself is deterministic and is not retried.
behavior.cancellation: Cancellation applies to the subsequent request, not resolution.
behavior.streaming: Routes do not imply streaming support.

valid.expected: The resolver returns the packed route for the key.

invalid.expectedFailure: The value is not a TeamRouteKey and is rejected.

compatibilityNotes: Actual endpoint behavior remains owned by the compatible gateway.
